Method of Attack: Ransomware and data extortion targeting healthcare and public health sector
Exploiting known vulnerabilities in VPN servers
Using compromised VPN credentials with MFA off
Lateral movement via RDP and SSH
Accessing VMware vCenter Server and resetting ESXi server passwords
Encrypting ESXi server files with extensions .vmdk, .vmem, .vswp, .vmsd, .vmx, .vmsn
Data exfiltration using Rclone or Ngrok to VPS
Double extortion by stealing and threatening to release PHI and PII
Discoverer: Department of Health and Human Services (HHS)
Impacted Systems: Healthcare and Public Health (HPH) sector systems
Indicators of Compromise: Use of Rclone or Ngrok for data exfiltration to VPS
